thought.text: The workspaces merge into one deegree workspace root (correct for deegree). Now deploy the config zips to XPLANBOX_CONFIG and set up the webapp.properties:

reasoning_content:
The workspace zip file contains deegree workspace files (datasources, appschemas, jdbc, etc.), and when extracted into /opt/deegree, it merges all the workspaces into a single deegree workspace root. This is actually the intended behavior — deegree uses a single workspace root containing all the configuration. Let me verify whether this is correct by checking the deegree workspace structure.

Actually, in deegree, DEEGREE_WORKSPACE_ROOT is the deegree workspace, and the contents of all these zips (datasources, appschemas, jdbc, services, themes, styles, etc.) get merged into a single deegree workspace. This is the correct behavior for deegree — there is one deegree workspace root, and multiple "workspaces" (services) are defined within it via webapp.properties.

Therefore, extracting all the zips into /opt/deegree is correct. Alright, let's continue with the deployment.
